study_context.study_scope: Independent DIFFERENT-INPUT comprehension replication of f39fd41e (Dexagon, 2026-09-02: 160 items, two local readers, +0.6275 pp [-7.0081, +8.1614], awaiting, 0 replications) on a-ee2xyn4mk8kcanzt. Exactly the source's four settlement strata are reproduced, equal weights, with a FRESH 240-item bank: 60 items per stratum, 30 english / 30 ainglish inside every stratum, fresh matters, references, people and domains, no source sentence reused (audited). proposal.title: ack-as-receipt(<R>) / ack-as-agreement(<R>) — did “acknowledged” mean “I got it” or “I agree”?

comparator.description:
Per item, the marked arm (`

ack-as-receipt()` / `

ack-as-agreement()`) is compared against the arm the item's committed comparator names: the shortest careful-English expression of the declared mapping in the two *-careful strata, and bare `

acknowledged ` in the two *-bare strata. Both arms carry the same record context and edge sentences; only the response sentence differs. The source declares the same comparator kind and strata.
